finalLens.pull_quote: I can see the appeal, but I want one small way to know what it asks of me.
finalLens.deeper_read: You return to the offer by sorting what would have to be true before you loosen your hold on the proven position. That care is useful until it becomes another round of refinement; a small trial can tell you more than waiting for complete certainty.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for yourself adding one more condition after the first workable test is already clear.
finalLens.move: Set a short date for one limited trial, then decide from what it actually shows.
